verdict.rationale: Clara documents a broad REST API and claims 'programmatic control over every aspect' of spend management. Documented coverage includes cards (create, update, lock, delete, configurations), transactions with labels and filters, users, invoices, Pix payments, webhooks, a published OpenAPI schema and an MCP server. However, true UI parity is only a vendor claim: UI features such as expense reporting and approvals and Clara Intelligence insights have no evidenced API equivalents, and API credentials themselves are managed in the dashboard. missing for 10: API coverage of expense reports, approvals and compliance workflows, API access to Clara Intelligence analytics and budgets, programmatic credential management, independent confirmation of UI–API parity
